articles.title: Council Splits 4–3 on Community Oven
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Laurel Drive disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Residents of Foundry Row said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. Councilmember Julla Marchetti asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $7,500.

articles.title: Letter: the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: I have lived on Rail Street for 24 years, and I want to say what a difference the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the winter coat drive in the budgct. Many of us on Rail Street use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the June meeting.
Simone Eckhart, Canal Park
